name: @telemax/generator-engine
description: Generic Generator Engine for Telemax AI Factory: register generators, run generation pipelines and produce artifacts, coordinating the Workflow Engine, AI Orchestrator, Prompt Engine and Knowledge Engine. Depends on @telemax/core, @telemax/knowledge, @telemax/prompt-engine, @telemax/ai and @telemax/workflow.
